parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs on doc_id to require PubMed-indexed provenance. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter by assay CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Return all requested columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
